design_rule: Each image exists to explain an exact economic/technical mechanism. No stock finance symbols, price-line decoration, or reused plate may stand in for a missing concept.

clusters.purpose: Move below both elevators and name the causal questions: memory is supported by demand/capacity/contracts/cash flow, while an index can turn diversification into concentration under automatic flows.
visual_sequence: local four-cable mechanism labels on the memory foundation
clusters.asset_strategy: approved callback plus local compositor surfaces; no new generic plate
must_not_imply: automatic contributions cause price outcomes by themselves

clusters.purpose: Teach HBM as stacked working memory physically adjacent to an AI accelerator, differentiated from ordinary storage through placement and data-transfer role—not text-heavy pseudo-diagrams.
Translate the GPU-engine/HBM-fuel-system analogy into an AI machine whose larger engine visibly starves at a narrow supply line, then expand the constraint to every accelerator class.
must_show: working data units queued at the channel
multiple generic accelerator forms resolving to the same memory gate

clusters.purpose: Make the shortage physical: advanced wafers, clean-room space, packaging, equipment, engineers, and time converge at one constrained HBM output gate.
must_show: room for local labels that appear only as each input is named
